references.title: Best Colostrum Supplements of 2026: Tester Approved

en.commentary: Colostrum is the supplement TikTok pushed into everyone's cart this year, and most of the 68-million-post hype skips the one number that decides whether a tub is worth your money: how much IgG you actually get per serving. That is the lens I ranked by. Transparent Labs Grass-Fed Colostrum takes the top spot because it does the boring thing brilliantly, packing a full 20 g scoop at a standardized 20% IgG and printing every gram on a third-party-tested label. When I compare cost per gram of actual immunoglobulins rather than cost per tub, it wins outright. ARMRA sits at second on the strength of its cold-chain BioPotent processing, which genuinely preserves bioactivity better than commodity spray-drying, and I rate it for people who prioritize sourcing and are happy to pay for it. WonderCow is my value champion at third, hitting a verified 30% IgG concentration from a family farm for well under a dollar a serving. The science deserves an honest caveat. A 2024 trial showed colostrum raises salivary IgA, yet a 2020 review found no significant immune-marker change in athletes, so I treat the immunity claims as promising rather than settled and lean on measurable specs instead. If you want gut and immune support with a real dose behind it, buy on IgG per serving and grass-fed sourcing, and you will land on one of my top three.

highlights.title: Buy on IgG per serving, not marketing
highlights.body: The single most useful filter for colostrum is grams of immunoglobulins you actually swallow. Transparent Labs prints a 20 g serving at 20% IgG on a third-party label, so you know exactly what you are getting. A 500 mg capsule at an unspecified IgG percentage is a different product at a different dose, and the price gap only makes sense once you do this math.

highlights.title: Transparent Labs earns number one on honest dosing
highlights.body: Plenty of brands sound premium, but Transparent Labs backs it with the highest verified dose here and a fully published panel. That combination of a heavy 20 g scoop, a standardized 20% IgG floor, and third-party testing is why it beats flashier names on the metric that matters.

highlights.title: ARMRA's edge is processing, and you pay for it
highlights.body: ARMRA's cold-chain BioPotent filtration preserves growth factors and immunoglobulins better than standard spray-drying, and its sourcing transparency is excellent. At roughly $1.67 per serving it is among the priciest options, so I recommend it to people who value bioactivity preservation above cost.

highlights.title: WonderCow is the value play at 30% IgG
highlights.body: A verified 30% IgG concentration from a seventh-generation family farm, cold-processed and third-party checked, at well under a dollar per serving. For daily users who want potency without the boutique markup, this is the smartest money on the list.

highlights.title: Respect the science gap before you commit
highlights.body: A 2024 study found colostrum raised salivary IgA, while a 2020 review saw no significant immune-marker shift in athletes. The evidence points in a hopeful direction without closing the case, so I rank on verifiable specs like IgG content, lactoferrin, grass-fed sourcing, and third-party testing rather than on health promises.

zh-tw.commentary: 牛初乳大概是今年 TikTok 硬塞進大家購物車的補給品，6,870 萬則貼文的熱度講得天花亂墜，卻幾乎都跳過真正決定一罐值不值得買的數字，就是你每份實際吃到多少 IgG。老實說，我這份排名就是用這個角度切的。Transparent Labs Grass-Fed Colostrum 拿第一，靠的是把最無聊的事做到最好，每份給滿 20 克，IgG 標示 20%，而且每一克都印在第三方檢驗的成分表上。你用每克免疫球蛋白的成本去算，而不是用每罐價格去算，它就是完勝。ARMRA 排第二，強在冷鏈 BioPotent 加工，確實比一般噴霧乾燥更能保留活性，我會推薦給重視來源、也願意為此多付錢的人。WonderCow 是我的性價比王者排第三，家族牧場出品、驗證 IgG 濃度 30%，每份還不到一美元。不過科學面該講的保留我一定講清楚。2024 年一項試驗顯示牛初乳能提升唾液 IgA，但 2020 年一篇回顧在運動員的免疫指標上沒看到顯著變化，所以我把免疫宣稱當成有潛力而非定案，實際排名還是靠可量化的規格。想要腸道跟免疫支持又要有真實劑量撐著，就照每份 IgG 跟草飼來源去挑，你最後一定會落在我前三名裡面。

highlights.title: 照每份 IgG 挑，別看行銷話術
highlights.body: 挑牛初乳最實用的濾網，就是你真正吞下肚的免疫球蛋白有幾克。Transparent Labs 每份 20 克、IgG 20%，全部印在第三方檢驗成分表上，你清清楚楚知道吃進什麼。一顆 500 毫克、IgG 百分比還不標的膠囊，根本是不同劑量的另一種產品，價差要用這個算法才看得懂。

highlights.title: Transparent Labs 靠誠實劑量拿第一
highlights.body: 講得像精品的品牌一堆，但 Transparent Labs 用這份清單裡最高的驗證劑量加完整公開的成分表撐起來。每份 20 克的扎實份量、標示 20% IgG 的底線、加上第三方檢驗，這個組合就是它在關鍵指標上贏過那些名氣更響品牌的原因。

highlights.title: ARMRA 的優勢在加工，代價就是貴
highlights.body: ARMRA 的冷鏈 BioPotent 過濾比一般噴霧乾燥更能保住生長因子與免疫球蛋白，來源透明度也做得很好。每份大約 1.67 美元，算是最貴的選項之一，所以我會把它推薦給把活性保留看得比價格重的人。

highlights.title: WonderCow 用 30% IgG 打性價比戰
highlights.body: 七代家族牧場出品，低溫加工、第三方檢驗，驗證 IgG 濃度 30%，每份還不到一美元。每天喝、想要效價又不想付精品溢價的人，這是整份清單裡最聰明的一筆錢。

highlights.title: 掏錢前先認清科學的落差
highlights.body: 2024 年一項研究發現牛初乳能提升唾液 IgA，2020 年一篇回顧在運動員身上卻沒看到免疫指標的顯著變化。證據方向樂觀但還沒蓋棺論定，所以我用 IgG 含量、乳鐵蛋白、草飼來源、第三方檢驗這些能驗證的規格來排名，不靠健康承諾。
